Author Lawrence Wright joins Danny Jones to talk about cults, dark rites, Scientology, and Israel and Palestine. Wright is a Pulitzer-winning writer known for books on faith and power. The episode title bills him as a cult investigator.

Wright shares what years of reporting taught him about groups that grip their members' lives. He moves from his Scientology work to the holy land and its long war. Jones asks how a writer earns trust in closed worlds. Listeners get the calm voice of a man who has sat with true believers of all kinds. The library files the talk as an archive record.
